#!/usr/bin/env python3
import csv
import json
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
censo = json.loads((ROOT / "evidencia" / "censo.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
rv = json.loads((ROOT / "evidencia" / "rv.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

assert len(censo) == 27, len(censo)
assert len(rv) == 36, len(rv)

CENSO_FIELDS = [
    "etapa", "punto", "eje", "severidad", "ancla", "referencias",
    "ubicacion", "accionable", "veracidad", "destino", "evidencia",
]
RV_FIELDS = ["etapa", "criterio", "resultado", "detalle"]

with (ROOT / "resultados-rubrica-revisor.csv").open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=RV_FIELDS)
    w.writeheader()
    w.writerows(rv)

with (ROOT / "censo-revision.csv").open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=CENSO_FIELDS)
    w.writeheader()
    w.writerows(censo)


def md_cell(text: str) -> str:
    return text.replace("|", "\\|").replace("\n", " ")


def rv_table(etapa: str) -> str:
    rows = [r for r in rv if r["etapa"] == etapa]
    lines = [
        "| Criterio | Resultado | Notas |",
        "|----------|-----------|-------|",
    ]
    for r in rows:
        lines.append(f"| {r['criterio']} | {r['resultado']} | {md_cell(r['detalle'])} |")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def censo_table(etapa: str) -> str:
    rows = [r for r in censo if r["etapa"] == etapa]
    lines = [
        "| punto | eje | severidad | ancla | referencias | ubicacion | accionable | veracidad | destino | evidencia |",
        "|-------|-----|-----------|-------|-------------|-----------|------------|-----------|---------|-----------|",
    ]
    for r in rows:
        lines.append("| " + " | ".join(md_cell(r[k]) for k in CENSO_FIELDS if k != "etapa") + " |")
    return "\n".join(lines)


src = (ROOT / "rubrica.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")

def fill(src: str, etapa: str, old: str) -> str:
    new = (
        f"### Resultados — etapa `{etapa}`\n\n"
        + rv_table(etapa)
        + f"\n\n#### Censo de puntos — `{etapa}`\n\n"
        + censo_table(etapa)
        + "\n"
    )
    assert old in src, etapa
    return src.replace(old, new)

empty = """| Criterio | Resultado | Notas |
|----------|-----------|-------|
| RV-01 | | |
| RV-02 | | |
| RV-03 | | |
| RV-04 | | |
| RV-05 | | |
| RV-06 | | |
| RV-07 | | |
| RV-08 | | |
| RV-09 | | |
| RV-10 | | |
| RV-11 | | |
| RV-12 | | |
"""

src = fill(src, "backend", "### Resultados — etapa `backend`\n\n" + empty)
src = fill(src, "web", "### Resultados — etapa `web`\n\n" + empty)
src = fill(src, "mobile", "### Resultados — etapa `mobile`\n\n" + empty)

header = "celda: celda-en-evaluacion\npasada: 2\nfecha: 2026-09-07\n\n"
(ROOT / "rubrica-completada.md").write_text(header + src, encoding="utf-8")
print("emitted", len(censo), "censo rows,", len(rv), "rv rows")
